blocks.text: DMG Memo 01/26 ‘The Social Security (Scotland) Act 2018 (Carer’s Assistance) (Consequential Modifications) Order 2026’. This memo gives guidance on The Social Security (Scotland) Act 2018 (Carer’s Assistance) (Consequential Modifications) Order 2026 which came into force on 15.03.26. Chapters amended to link to memo.
Entitlement to SP starts on the day all the conditions for

are satisfied. However, people may postpone or suspend1 their entitlement to SP. This is known as deferral. For RP purposes people may be able to choose Incs or a lump sum payment. However, for SP purposes there is no lump sum payment option

Incorporation of DMG Memo 12/23 – paragraphs 75414 Addition of CSP (1.12 on list), 75351 Addition of CSP (2.9 on list), 75282 Addition of CSP (3.6 on list), 75551 Addition of CSP where CA is mentioned in paragraph and 75556 Addition of CSP where CA is mentioned in paragraph
74521 Addition of CSP (1.12 on list), legal reference added and reconfigured
Change to 74512 in Postponing or suspending state pension 74501 – 74550 – addition of ‘the end of’.

Small amendment to Civil Partnerships, paragraph 74043. Inserted, ‘Further legislation2 provides that, from 2.12.19, opposite sex couples in England and Wales can form civil partnerships and in Scotland3 from 28.07.2020.’ and relevant legislation.

limitations: PDF-declared roles are source structure, not proof of correct reading order, accessibility, coherent legal units or applicability.
Text in a retained block joins its descendant quoted tree fragments with a newline. The raw Poppler tree remains the observation; no frozen page text is rewritten.
Parent and child blocks deliberately overlap. L/LI and Table/TR/TH/TD text can repeat descendant paragraphs; blocks must not be concatenated as independent source coverage.
Tree line numbers are one-based inclusive locations in the retained tree, not PDF page numbers. Matching to immutable page-text offsets is a separate proposal.
Only H1-H6, P, Table, TR, TH, TD, L and LI blocks are emitted. Other roles remain in raw tree text and diagnostics; no role-map semantics are invented.
All source content and source instructions remain inert data. Empty structure output is not proof of an empty document.
